description: This file contains the implementation of the MasterRepository class, which provides data access methods for managing master/reference tables in the database, including entities like UOM, reporting programs, control devices, equations, and status codes. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and querying these entities, with detailed SQL commands and data mapping.

classes.name: MasterRepository
classes.description: Sealed class providing asynchronous methods to manage master/reference data in the database, such as UOMs, reporting programs, control devices, equations, and status codes. It uses dependency injection for connection factory and logging, and includes helper methods for data handling.

methods.name: CreateUomAsync
methods.description: Creates a new UOM master record in the database and returns the created DTO.

methods.name: GetUomByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a UOM record by its ID if it exists and is not deleted.

methods.name: UpdateUomAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing UOM record identified by its ID.

methods.name: QueryUomsAsync
methods.description: Returns a list of UOM records matching query parameters, with optional filtering by activity status.

methods.name: CreateReportingProgramAsync
methods.description: Creates a new reporting program record and returns its DTO.

methods.name: GetReportingProgramByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a reporting program by ID if it exists and is not deleted.

methods.name: UpdateReportingProgramAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing reporting program by its ID.

methods.name: QueryReportingProgramsAsync
methods.description: Returns a list of reporting programs with optional filtering.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceAsync
methods.description: Creates a control device record with site ID normalization.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a control device by its ID.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing control device record.

methods.name: QueryControlDevicesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves control device records filtered by optional site ID and activity status.

methods.name: CreateEquationAsync
methods.description: Creates an equation master record.

methods.name: GetEquationByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches an equation record by ID.

methods.name: UpdateEquationAsync
methods.description: Updates an equation master record.

methods.name: QueryEquationsAsync
methods.description: Lists equations with optional filters.

methods.name: CreateStatusCodeAsync
methods.description: Creates a new status code record.

methods.name: GetStatusCodeByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a status code by ID.

methods.name: UpdateStatusCodeAsync
methods.description: Updates a status code record.

methods.name: QueryStatusCodesAsync
methods.description: Lists status codes with optional filters.
